summary: Navigation and footer/homepage CTAs were refocused away from “Models”, and the /models route appears removed from App.tsx. However, model-related pages/components (InteractiveModelsPage and calculators under frontend/src/components/models/**) still exist and were modified rather than retired/deleted, leaving significant “Models” functionality in the codebase. Evidence is insufficient to confirm removal of all remaining “Models” references and model-related static assets.
